map.邮件标题测试 使用指南: Email Subject Line Tester - User Guide
map.输入邮件标题文本，检测其中的垃圾邮件触发词、分析情感倾向与不同客户端的显示效果，: Enter email subject-line text; detect spam trigger words, analyze sentiment and display across clients, helping improve open and delivery rates.
map.群发前用评分筛掉易被判定垃圾邮件的标题。: Before mass sending, use the score to filter out subject lines easily flagged as spam.
map.A/B 多版标题按长度、个性化、敏感词维度打分选优。: Score A/B title variants by length, personalization and sensitive-word dimensions to pick the best.
map.电商促销标题避免感叹号堆砌和「免费」等触发词。: E-commerce promo subject lines avoid piling exclamation marks and trigger words like "free".
map.：「【限时】点击领取你的专属优惠券！！！」—— 过长、3 个感叹号、含「领取/免: : "[Limited] Click to claim your exclusive coupon!!!" - too long, 3 exclamation marks, contains trigger words like "claim/free"; high spam risk, low predicted open rate.
map.：「3 个技巧帮你本周完成季度目标」—— 长度适中、有具体利益点、无敏感词，预览: : "3 tips to help you hit this quarter's goal this week" - moderate length, specific benefit, no sensitive words; preview shows value, better open rate.
map.标题里能加 emoji 吗？: Can emoji be added in the subject line?
map.少量、相关 emoji 可提升打开率，但堆砌或行业敏感（金融/医疗）反而易进垃圾: A few relevant emoji can lift open rate, but piling up or industry-sensitive (finance/medical) ones instead land in spam; suggest A/B testing.
map.评分能替代真实发送测试吗？: Can the score replace real send testing?
map.不能。评分只排查明显雷区，最终打开率仍要小流量 A/B 实测，受发送时间、列表质: No. The score only screens obvious pitfalls; final open rate still needs small-traffic A/B testing, affected by send time and list quality.
